en-US.title: MiLaundry PH
en-US.subtitle: The till for your laundry
en-US.description:
Milaundry is the till for a neighbourhood laundry.

A customer scans the code at the counter, or opens the shop’s own page. They book a wash, follow the load, and pick it up without a phone call.

At the counter the shop weighs, takes payment, prints a receipt, and rings when a booking comes in. Walk-ins you type yourself stay quiet. Online orders ring.

Each laundry has its own page, its own prices, its own logo. This is not a marketplace of shops. It is the shop.

Made for laundries in the Philippines.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release on the App Store.
en-US.promoText: Scan the counter code. Follow the load.

review.notes:
Sign in is a Philippine mobile number and a password. There is no email login and no SMS one-time code.

Apple Review can create an account from Welcome → Sign up with any unused PH mobile number, then a password of 8+ characters.

The camera is used to scan laundry QR codes at the counter. Location is used only to pin a shop on a map. Photos are used for shop logos, covers, weigh pictures, and payment receipts.

This app has no ads, no in-app purchases, and no gambling.
